title: Hang when using Redis as a cache provider on some configurations
body:
### Issue description

When using Redis as a cache provider, the app hangs when establishing a connection to the database.

### Expected Behavior

TypeORM does not hang.

### Actual Behavior

TypeORM hangs when trying to establish a connection to the database when using Redis as the cache provider.

This issue happens on :
- Debian 11 (using [Node Source builds](https://github.com/nodesource/distributions#deb))
- Fedora 37
- Docker

This issue *does not happens* on :
- Arch Linux
- Fedora 38

Each run was done on a freshly installed virtual machine to get a clean environment.

### Steps to reproduce

I created a repository with a reproducible example using Docker [here](https://github.com/ttcchhmm/typeorm-redis-hang).

### My Environment

| Dependency          | Version  |
| ---                 | ---      |
| Operating System    | Debian 11, Fedora 37, Docker |
| Node.js version     | 19.x, 20.x  |
| Typescript version  | 4.5.2  |
| TypeORM version     | 0.3.15  |
| `redis` | 4.6.5 |
| `pg` | 8.4.0 |

### Additional Context

_No response_
